# axm skills list

List installed skills

## When to use

List installed skills

## Usage

```bash
axm skills list [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

| Name      | Type   | Required | Description                                                                             |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope` | choice | No       | List skills from project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--agent` | string | No       | Show only skills installed for specific agent(s)                                        |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**See what skills are installed**

```bash
axm skills list
```

**Check user-level skills**

```bash
axm skills list --scope user
```

**See skills for a specific agent**

```bash
axm skills list --agent claude-code
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
